title: Trivial inertia gives trivial intersection with a prime-cyclotomic field
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ, let E be a finite-dimensional Galois intermediate field of Ω/ℚ, let q be a natural prime, and let ζ ∈ Ω be a primitive qth root of unity. Assume that every valuation subring V of E in which q is a nonunit has trivial rational inertia subgroup. Then E ∩ ℚ(ζ) = ℚ, equivalently E ⊓ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {ζ} = ⊥.
lean_statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (q : ℕ) (ζ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ), q.Prime → IsPrimitiveRoot ζ q → (∀ V : ValuationSubring E, V.LiesOverPrime q → ∀ τ : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E, τ ∈ V.inertiaSubgroupIn ℚ → τ = 1) → E ⊓ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({ζ} : Set (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) = ⊥
